question: Will BTC reach $85k by Wednesday 9/30/2026 00:00 UTC

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase reaches $85,000.00 or higher at any point before the observation window deadline (Sep 30, 2026, 00:00 UTC).
- "No": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase does not reach $85,000.00 or higher at any point before the observation window deadline (Sep 30, 2026, 00:00 UTC).

Clarifications:
- "Reaches $85k" means the BTC-USD spot price traded at or above $85,000.00 on Coinbase at any moment during the observation window, not solely at the moment of settlement.
